tasks.title: Quant node: z-score + momentum signals
tasks.objective: Tests-first: implement src/quant/signals.py so the pre-seeded tests/test_signals.py passes. Exact API: compute_z_score(prices: pd.Series, window: int = 20) -> float (rolling mean/std with pandas defaults, ddof=1; zero or NaN std -> 0.0); compute_momentum_slope(prices: pd.Series, fast: int = 10, step: int = 5) -> float ((ma10.iloc[-1] - ma10.iloc[-step]) / step); generate_signal(prices: pd.Series) -> dict with keys signal/confidence/z_score/momentum. Rules: BUY when z < -1.5 AND slope > -0.5 with confidence min(0.95, abs(z)*0.4); SELL when z > 1.5 with confidence min(0.95, z*0.4); else HOLD with confidence 0.5. Insufficient data (< window+step samples) -> HOLD/0.5/0.0/0.0. No I/O; only pandas/numpy imports.
acceptance_criteria: tests/test_signals.py collected and fully green (no skips)

tasks.title: Market data adapter over the cache
tasks.objective: Tests-first: implement src/data/market_data.py so tests/test_market_data.py passes. Exact API: class DataError(Exception); module-level def _download(ticker: str, period: str) -> pandas.DataFrame that wraps yfinance (import yfinance inside the function; progress=False) -- this is the ONLY yfinance seam; def fetch_ohlcv(ticker: str, period: str = '6mo', cache: Cache | None = None) -> pd.DataFrame: cache-first (cache key f'ohlcv:{ticker}:{period}'), on miss calls _download, raises DataError on empty/None frame, stores fetched frame in cache -- JSON-safe recipe (CRITICAL): build the payload via frame.reset_index().to_dict(orient='list') and then convert the datetime index column values to ISO-8601 strings via .isoformat(); a payload containing pd.Timestamp values makes Cache.set raise TypeError('Value is not JSON-serializable') and fails the real-test gate. On a cache hit rebuild with pd.DataFrame(stored), parse the index column back with pd.to_datetime, and set_index(index_col) (set index.name=None when the column is named 'index'). Cache API contract (src/data/cache.py, shipped by TASK-7003A -- read that file before writing code): `from src.data.cache import Cache`; `Cache(root: pathlib.Path, ttl_seconds: float = 300.0)`; `def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]` -- takes EXACTLY one positional argument, returns the cached value or None on miss/expiry (no default parameter, no keyword args); `def set(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None` -- value must be JSON-serializable or it raises TypeError. On fetch miss: store with `cache.set(cache_key, payload)` where payload is the ISO-8601-stringified reset_index dict described above (pd.Timestamp values are NOT JSON-serializable); on hit: rebuild with `pd.DataFrame(cache.get(cache_key))` restoring the DatetimeIndex from the stored index column via pd.to_datetime + set_index. Never pass a raw pandas DataFrame to cache.set.
acceptance_criteria: no yfinance import at module import time (lazy inside _download)
